map.保温时间估算：由厚度与工艺估保温时长，便于排产: Hold time estimate: estimate the hold duration from the thickness and the process, which helps scheduling
map.工艺管理：记录炉温曲线，追溯每炉参数: Process management: log the furnace temperature curve and trace the parameters of every firing
map.质量核查：对比实测与目标温度，判工艺合规: Quality check: compare the measured temperature against the target to judge process compliance
map.系数 k 从哪来？: Where does the coefficient k come from?
map.是经验估算系数（基于\"厚度每增1mm约加 k 分钟+基础20分\"），不同工艺: It is an empirical coefficient (based on "each extra 1mm of thickness adds about k minutes plus a base of 20"), with different k for different processes because of differences in heat conduction and phase change; in reality it must be adjusted to the process specification and the furnace type, so this tool is a scheduling reference only.
map.渗碳保温由渗层深度决定（约0.12–0.15mm/h），与时间近线性而非厚度主导: The carburising hold is determined by the case depth (about 0.12-0.15mm/h) and is close to linear in time rather than thickness-driven; thin parts can also take a long time, so a separate estimate by case depth is provided.
